tool_args.rationale: Two stationary branch fits failed confirmation, so I revise the model rather than repeat them: retain the supplied sink-modulated saturating pool and fit a continuous thresholded nonlinear leak to explain the high-gradient decline and sign reversal. The available observations do not indicate chaotic behavior.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The high-gradient probe already showed the sign reversal, and another observation in the same region is less useful than testing a revised thresholded response against fresh confirmation.
That probe has already been acquired; its added rows do not vary horizon and do not support a new horizon-dynamics distinction.
It is explicitly irrelevant to the response-law ambiguity and should not be purchased.
The observed responses are smooth and systematic, not high-frequency chaotic; a revised stationary thresholded-leak model remains testable.
